title: [GMCP 203.009.06] Operations and evidence: Complete tool server surface
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-009-06. Ship inspectable CLI, TUI or API state, configuration validation, bounded metrics/logs/traces, diagnostics, examples, migration and rollback guidance, incident runbooks, and reproducible evidence artifacts. Automate drift detection so a changed dependency or standard invalidates stale proof. Vector outcome: Tool discovery, deterministic pagination/filtering, list-change signaling, invocation, structured and unstructured results, output-schema validation, annotations, icons, errors, cancellation, progress, caching, idempotency declarations, and concurrent execution all work through the production registry. Tool identity and schema changes are versioned, calls are policy-gated, and success is impossible when declared output contracts are violated. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
